$comment: Operational acceptance contract, backed by the October 7 incident. This file documents checks; no n8n workflow or scheduled observer consumes it yet. New automated safeguards require a separate reviewed implementation.
scope: Shared HubSpot Programs/HubDB reader and its downstream publishing jobs
authorization: Existing actor, ticket, source-owner and workflow-owner approval rules still apply. This contract does not authorize mutations or automatic retries.

checks.requirement: Return each eligible Program ID exactly once; preserve intentional visibility, lifecycle and online filters plus any explicitly requested IDs.
evidence: returned ID set and unique count
checks.paginationTest: Exercise more than one page using a bounded lower page size when needed. Follow the returned cursor, reject repeated cursors/overlapping ID sets, and compare full ID sets. A total above 100 alone does not prove a pagination defect.
checks.enforcement: Cursor pagination observed in production; independent coverage and uniqueness checks performed during incident investigation. Recurring preflight not deployed by this change.

checks.requirement: For every hubspot_program_interest group with multiple aliases, exactly one approved row must have is_primary=1. A single-row group may have is_primary=0 under the existing reader. Check the entire proposed table, including currently ineligible Programs.
checks.onFailure: Identify ambiguous groups and obtain a canonical mapping decision. Do not choose the first row, delete aliases, suppress duplicate IDs, or change Program identities to force a pass.
checks.enforcement: Operator prepublication check documented here; automated HubDB prepublication guard not deployed. Known out-of-scope ambiguous groups remain in the incident follow-up.

checks.requirement: Joined Program IDs must equal the raw eligible ID set and appear exactly once. Compare selected aliases and full event associations with the approved expected diff, not just row counts.
evidence: counts and ID sets before/after each join
duplicate IDs and contributing HubDB rows
checks.enforcement: Existing production duplicate-ID guard retained. Set-equality and regression checks were run during incident recovery; continuous enforcement not added.

checks.requirement: Compare draft and published tables before editing; do not publish unrelated draft changes. Back up, approve a minimal diff, recheck for concurrent changes, publish, read back and verify the exact diff. Roll back only the changed fields after checking for newer edits.
checks.enforcement: Operator procedure; completed for the October 7 two-flag repair. No new automatic publisher.

checks.requirement: A source correction is verified by a new reader invocation with fresh source nodes and cache refresh. A retry ID or loadWorkflow=true does not prove upstream nodes were reread.
evidence: source-node timestamps at or after start
checks.enforcement: Operator recovery procedure; not an automated retry policy.

checks.requirement: Validate the final rendered payload for every listing after all substitutions and whitespace normalization. Preserve approved lifecycle/enrollment meaning; no blind truncation or disabling validators.
checks.enforcement: Existing Rio quality gates observed in production. The October 7 overlength template correction remains outstanding.

checks.requirement: Track reader recovery separately from each consumer. Attribute alerts to workflow, execution, failed node and error class. Before retrying a writer, inspect completed writes and import receipts. HTTP acceptance is not proof of completed import or public correctness.
evidence: next normal run and public verification when applicable
checks.enforcement: Operator triage/closure procedure. Automated incident grouping and recovery notifications are proposed, not deployed.

followUpAutomation.action: Add the primary-selection and join-coverage checks before publishing/consuming mapping changes; include inactive groups in an audit so newly eligible campuses cannot expose latent ambiguity.
Add a multi-page regression case with overlapping-page failure and exact ID-set coverage; keep production business filters.
Group repeats by root workflow and error signature, retain per-execution evidence and notify on first failure, meaningful change and recovery. Do not globally suppress unrelated errors.
